patches.description: Neutralizes LicenseActivity.onStart to prevent the paywall and error dialog from being displayed, acting as a catch-all guard if LicenseActivity is ever started.
patches.name: Bypass License Activity

patches.description: Bypasses Google Play Store license verification in com.pairip.licensecheck.LicenseClient to prevent System.exit(0) on non-Play Store installs.
patches.name: Bypass License Check

patches.description: Neutralizes the license paywall and error dialog at the source by patching LicenseClient.processResponse, startPaywallActivity, and handleError to return immediately.
patches.name: Bypass License Paywall

patches.description: Bypasses APK signature verification in com.pairip.SignatureCheck to prevent SignatureTamperedException on modified APKs.
patches.name: Bypass Signature Verification

patches.description: Disables the blacklisting check in the affirmation flow to prevent the app from blocking rooted devices server-side.
patches.name: Disable Blacklisting

patches.description: Forces the root status to 'safe' in device details and skips root status comparison logic to bypass root detection on the client side.
patches.name: Force Safe Root Status
